description: Look up a Sei transaction by hash: sender, recipient, value in SEI, nonce, gas limit, the 4-byte function selector and its block. Use to see what was sent or whether it exists; for success or failure and fees paid use sei_receipt, for emitted events sei_logs. Input is a 0x-prefixed 64-hex hash; an unknown hash returns 404, uncharged. Example: hash=0x51ee2bca2ed878b0f576071a0cd21c0f8f129d4de4a545c5a7b3511fa6d048bb. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: sei_tx
title: Sei transaction
